notes.subject: feat(agent): make the final-status summary the single home for the final response
notes.summary: The built-in agent now writes its complete final response in the final-status summary instead of writing it as text first and then recapping it, and the summary is sized to its content.

notes.subject: feat(browser-gateway): align Ask Agent final responses with the summary-only contract
notes.summary: Ask Agent now puts its complete final response in the status summary, and a summary-only reply is no longer shown twice in the chat, while history and memory still keep the content.
